title: Ceylon becomes an independent dominion
summary: On 4 February 1948 a new constitution took effect under the Ceylon Independence Act of 1947, making Ceylon a self-governing dominion within the British Commonwealth. D. S. Senanayake, who had negotiated dominion status with the British during the Second World War and founded the United National Party, led the new government. The United States recognised Ceylon the same day.

where.modern_name: Colombo, Sri Lanka (proxy pin: Independence Square, Colombo; no opened page names the ceremony venue)

importance.justification: Ceylon gained dominion status by negotiation, ending British colonial rule on the island.
